nodes.title: Relational lexicon: a romance ask with no possessive is romance in all three surfaces. 'सच में गर्लफ्रेंड बन जाओ', 'gf banogi kya', 'girlfriend ban jaao', 'become my girlfriend' and 'will you be my bf' now map to romance_brief: kind and brief, an AI teacher, no comment on looks, back to the work; no helpline. The form needs a second-person or wanting verb, so reported ('usne bola…'), past ('ban gayi'), negated and kinship talk stays quiet. Insults ('tum pagal ho', 'I hate you') and 'kitna time bacha hai' from the same open item are NOT relational-floor signals: no floor rule is at stake, her persona answers them, and the continuer already refuses them by its NEVER list. They stay out of the lexicon.
nodes.reversal: a TEST or production turn where the bare form fires on a reported or kinship sentence, or an insult that needs a floor move (bullying of the child is scanSafety's, not this lexicon's)

md.decisions:
## dc-r143-romance-bare-ask (2026-10-15)

**What:** a romance ask with no possessive ("सच में गर्लफ्रेंड बन जाओ", "gf banogi kya", "become my girlfriend") is romance and gets romance_brief, with no helpline.

**Scope:**

- The form needs a second-person or wanting verb.
- Reported, past, negated and kinship talk stays quiet.
- Insults and time questions stay out of the lexicon: no floor rule is at stake.

**Reversal:** a firing on reported or kinship talk.
